campus.willow_park.name: Qindu Campus Willow Park
campus.willow_park.canon: Modern 2025 Qindu University athletic field perimeter and quiet willow park at night, red synthetic running track beside manicured green lawns, wooden park bench beside recycling bin, contemporary glass academic faculty towers under floodlit night sky.

troposphere.stele.name: High Troposphere Golden Stele
troposphere.stele.canon: High troposphere and stratosphere perspective at night, thirty-thousand-metre colossal obsidian-and-gold primordial stone stele descending through storm clouds, iridescent violet and golden primordial starlight auroras overlooking Qindu skyline.

campus.perimeter_gate.name: North Campus Perimeter Gate Cordon
campus.perimeter_gate.canon: North campus perimeter security cordon of Qindu University at night, reinforced tungsten security barricades, Threat Bureau armored tactical command carriers with glowing communications radar, high-intensity searchlights sweeping campus perimeter fence.

starfall.penthouse.name: Starfall Tower Penthouse Executive Suite
starfall.penthouse.canon: Panoramic penthouse executive suite atop Starfall Tower at night, polished dark obsidian marble floors, floor-to-ceiling panoramic glass overlooking illuminated Jiangnan metropolis, glowing holographic radar terminals, regal purple cosmic starlight ambient glow.

stadium.clean_arena.name: Qindu Stadium Clean Athletic Arena
stadium.clean_arena.canon: Modern 2025 Qindu University athletic stadium at night, red synthetic running track surrounding clean green athletic turf, elevated brushed-steel proctor podium with lectern, tiered metal spectator bleachers packed with students, high LED stadium floodlight towers under dark night sky.

stadium.frosted_arena.name: Qindu Stadium Glacial Frosted Arena
stadium.frosted_arena.canon: Modern 2025 Qindu University athletic stadium at night, glistening glacial cyan ice crystals and frost mist coating the central arena, crystalline glacial lotus ice barriers standing beside the proctor podium, red synthetic running track and bleachers in background under high LED stadium floodlights.

stadium.impact_crater.name: Qindu Stadium 30m Impact Crater
stadium.impact_crater.canon: Shattered thirty-metre circular impact crater sunken into the athletic stadium track floor at night, cracked concrete foundation and pulverized stone rubble, fine grey dust and golden starlight motes drifting in air, metal stadium bleachers and high LED floodlights in background.

dorm.402.name: Qindu University Dormitory Room 402
dorm.402.canon: Clean modern Qindu University male dormitory Room 402 at night, single brushed-steel lofted bunk bed with neat grey bedding, minimalist study desk below with stainless steel electric kettle, matte white walls, spotless clean tiled floor, window overlooking campus night lamps.

campus.pathway.name: Qindu University Campus Pathway
campus.pathway.canon: Modern 2025 Qindu University campus shaded avenue and collegiate promenade during bright crisp morning daylight, contemporary glass academic faculty buildings, manicured green trees, clean stone pavers under clear high-key sky.

pavilion.auction_hall.name: Jiangnan Celestial Pavilion Auction Hall
pavilion.auction_hall.canon: High-end subterranean Jiangnan Celestial Spirit Auction Grand Pavilion, opulent modern multi-tier circular auditorium with brushed gold balustrades, tiered VIP skyboxes, central velvet-covered display pedestal under concentrated warm spotlights.

pavilion.vip_suite.name: Celestial Pavilion Private VIP Suite
pavilion.vip_suite.canon: Private VIP suite inside Jiangnan Celestial Spirit Auction, floor-to-ceiling one-way polarized glass overlooking auction auditorium, plush leather seating, tea service table, warm ambient luxury lighting.

gu_syndicate.headquarters.name: Gu Syndicate Obsidian Tower Boardroom

gu_syndicate.courtyard_plaza.name: Gu Syndicate Obsidian Tower Entrance Plaza

campus.formation_cordon.canon: Qindu University collegiate district perimeter under a colossal runic crimson slaughter barrier, crackling crimson runic energy dome enclosing the modern street grid, crimson-ruby mist hovering over asphalt roadways, abandoned civilian vehicles.
